elementals-unbound-tempest.name: Elementals - Unbound Tempest
elementals-unbound-tempest.summary: Play elementals to scale from big shop
elementals-unbound-tempest.when_to_commit: Brann Bronzebeard + shop buff (Nomi, Kitchen Nightmare) + Unbound Tempest
elementals-unbound-tempest.common_enablers:
Brann Bronzebeard
Tavern Tempest + Kelp Keeper
elementals-unbound-tempest.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
elementals-unbound-tempest.how_to_play: Shop-buff engine: open with whichever of [[Nomi, Kitchen Nightmare||63626]] or [[Air Revenant||126173]] appears first. Core economy and generation: [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Tavern Tempest||64077]] + [[Kelp Keeper||132883]]. [[Flaming Enforcer||126924]] is the midgame stabilizer. Late game [[Unbound Tempest||132983]] raises the cap - cycle premium elementals under it ([[Sellemental||64038]], [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]]).

mechs-magnetics-spells.name: Mechs - Magnetics/Spells
mechs-magnetics-spells.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
mechs-magnetics-spells.how_to_play: Targeted spells go on Mechs while [[Glambot||132893]] is on board; [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] doubles each cast. Fuel the loop with spell generation ([[Captain Cookie||133075]]) and gem cyclers ([[Fearless Foodie||113154]]), and buy Pointy Arrow on sight. Mid-to-late, [[Utility Drone||98588]] converts the magnetics Glambot accumulated into real stats.

beasts-tasty-lobstah.name: Beasts - Tasty Lobstah
beasts-tasty-lobstah.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
beasts-tasty-lobstah.how_to_play: Deathrattle-multiplication comp: fire [[Tasty Lobster||132796]] as often as possible. Rallies plus [[Deathstrider||132808]] and [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] re-trigger it each time; a golden [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]] moves those triggers into the shop phase - buy every [[Snarky Shark||132804]] and [[Lurking Lionfish||132794]] you see. Defensive finish: reborn + taunt the Lobster, and give the Gryphon windfury with [[Sprightly Scarab||108909]].

murlocs-venom-scam.name: Murlocs - Venom Scam
murlocs-venom-scam.summary: Buy scam cards and try to preserve placements
murlocs-venom-scam.when_to_commit: When you have no future or are clearly getting outstatted
murlocs-venom-scam.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
murlocs-venom-scam.how_to_play: Scam board. Buy every poison/reborn piece and concentrate stats on few units so your trades stay lopsided; the rest of the board exists to trade evenly at worst. Golden [[Expert Aviator||126637]] with venom from [[Bile Spitter||122219]] floods the fight with scam from hand. [[Sky-hatch Runaway||132957]] can hand out permanent venom instead.

pirates-apm-golden.name: Pirates - APM Golden
pirates-apm-golden.summary: Use infinite money to scale pirates
pirates-apm-golden.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
pirates-apm-golden.how_to_play: Infinite-gold package: [[Enterprising Escapee||132762]] behind [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] + [[Proud Privateer||122520]], with [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] accelerating the loop. Once infinite, goldens and discovers never stop, and all of them feed [[Hooktusk, Master Marauder||132925]]. Keep buying discovers to scale. Higher-cap endgame pivot: the Demons shop-buff comp.

demons-shop-buff.name: Demons - Shop Buff
demons-shop-buff.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
demons-shop-buff.how_to_play: Shop-scaling comp. [[Devilish Distractor||132901]] buffs the shop, doubled by [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]]. The payoff then eats the buffed shop - usually [[Felboar||110664]], otherwise [[Twisted Wrathguard||130662]] or reborn [[Imp-lusionist||132899]]. Cast [[Methodical Madness||132903]] into shops holding divine shield or venomous units to spread the keywords across your demons.

undead-attack-scaling.name: Undead - Attack Scaling
undead-attack-scaling.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
undead-attack-scaling.how_to_play: Butchering engine. The [[Drustfallen Butcher||120104]] spell scales attack, and [[Friendly Geist||120219]] grows it; [[Handless Forsaken||95265]] sets summon quality. [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] banks stats off the right-most unit in combat and in the shop phase, so butcher your reborn units into it. Strongest line: [[Dead Bellringer||132322]] + [[Mummifier||108992]] - reborn the whole board, then loop bellringer activate -> reborn -> butcher, one spell at a time, for a wall of Snazzy procs.

beasts-leviathan.name: Beasts - Leviathan
beasts-leviathan.when_to_commit: Early Lurking Leviathan + Beast summons (Sewer Lord)
beasts-leviathan.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
beasts-leviathan.how_to_play: Summon snowball. Get an early [[Lurking Leviathan||130711]], then summon as many Beasts as you can. Best summoner is a reborn [[Sewer lord||130996]]; Hoarding Hyena's taunt summon is next. [[Banana Slamma||98824]] turns every summon into a serious attacker.

quilboar-choose-one.name: Quilboar - Choose One
quilboar-choose-one.summary: Play Choose One cards to scale
quilboar-choose-one.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
quilboar-choose-one.how_to_play: Gem engine with a choose-one payoff. Scale gems through [[Gem rat||116434]] or [[Sanguine Refiner||122566]]. The payoff is [[Turbo Hogrider||116195]]. Generate extra choose-ones ([[Gem rat||116434]], [[Bramble Tunneler||132632]]) and cycle every decent one - the only skips are [[Intrepid Botanist||120223]] and [[Time Management||117573]].

dragons-battlecries.name: Dragons - Battlecries
dragons-battlecries.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
dragons-battlecries.how_to_play: Battlecry engine. [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] + [[Kalecgos, Arcane Aspect||60630]] means +4/+4 to all Dragons per battlecry, so trigger as many as possible. Once set up, cycle only premium battlecries - [[Tavern Tempest||64077]], [[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]], [[Shell Collector||80740]], [[Draconic Warden||126860]]. Highest cap: find a double-attack spell each turn and let [[Persistent Poet||108463]] make [[Warpwing||92413]]'s attack doubling permanent; [[Amber Guardian||95006]] and [[Thousandth Paper Drake||108116]] attach permanent divine shield and windfury to it.

beasts-beetles.name: Beasts - Beetles
beasts-beetles.when_to_commit: Early Ravaging Scorpid or Turquoise Skitterer
beasts-beetles.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
beasts-beetles.how_to_play: Beetle scaling. Open with [[Ravaging Scorpid||132949]] or [[Turquoise Skitterer||119255]] to grow beetle stats. [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]] generates comp pieces, with [[Snarky Shark||132804]] helping. Run as many [[Banana Slamma||98824]] as you can - each doubles beetle attack and cracks tall boards.

demons-self-damage.name: Demons - Self Damage
demons-self-damage.when_to_commit: Ashen Corruptor + self damage (Wrath Weaver or Malchezaar, Prince of Dance) + payoff (Tichondrius or Eredar Escapist)
demons-self-damage.common_enablers: Wrath Weaver + Soul Rewinder demon midgame
demons-self-damage.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
demons-self-damage.how_to_play: Self-damage engine. Hurt your own hero ([[Malchezaar, Prince of Dance||99199]], [[Wrath Weaver||59670]], or trinkets) while [[Ashen Corruptor||121687]] converts that damage into shop buffs; [[Tichondrius||99228]] stabilizes the midgame. [[Eredar Escapist||133028]] cupcake generation is the late payoff - target the Corruptor. [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]] doubles both cupcakes and [[Devilish Distractor||132901]]. Under the Weaver, each Demon you play discounts the next spell to zero - feed that with [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] and cycled [[Imposing Percussionist||99232]].

beasts-summons.name: Beasts - Summons
beasts-summons.when_to_commit: Headhunter Gryphon + Deathstrider + Goldrinn, the Great Wolf
beasts-summons.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
beasts-summons.how_to_play: Goldrinn beast snowball. A midgame [[Headhunter Gryphon||132800]] generates beasts while you assemble the core. Pop [[Goldrinn, the Great Wolf||59955]] in the shop phase via [[Deathstrider||132808]]; [[Titus Rivendare||97408]] doubles the whole strategy. Force the Gryphon to attack with the [[Lurking Lionfish||132794]] activate or cycled [[Snarky Shark||132804]] - chaining shop attacks generates more of both. [[Sewer Lord||130996]] + [[Banana Slamma||98824]] finish under the Goldrinn aura with huge-attack summons.

undead-apm-undead.name: Undead - APM Undead
undead-apm-undead.summary: Scale undead attack with infinite gold
undead-apm-undead.when_to_commit: Bounty Generation (Sky Admiral Rogers) + Proud Privateer + Forsaken Weaver
undead-apm-undead.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
undead-apm-undead.how_to_play: Infinite-gold Undead scaling. [[Sky Admiral Rogers||122516]] + [[Proud Privateer||122520]] print the gold; add [[Enterprising Escapee||132762]] / [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] until you are infinite, then cut them for board slots. Cycle all free cards ([[Refreshing Anomaly||64042]]). Spend the gold on bounties and [[Forsaken Weaver||126733]] casts to scale Undead attack; a reborn golden [[Handless Forsaken||95265]] anchors the board. [[Snazzy Phantom||133083]] turns reborn pops ([[Maw Caster||121508]], [[Disguised Graverobber||104610]]) into permanent stats.

murlocs-tidecaller.name: Murlocs - Tidecaller
murlocs-tidecaller.when_to_commit: Brann Bronzebeard + lots of economy + Shamanic Tidecaller
murlocs-tidecaller.source: hsreplay.net comp pages via scrape_comps.py (last re-scrape 2026-09-23); guide text rewritten as original advice 2026-09-24
murlocs-tidecaller.how_to_play: Tidecaller finisher. Build economy first: golden [[Brann Bronzebeard||96786]] or Brann + [[Magicfin Mycologist||122277]], keep the top-shelf economy spells - Cloning Conch, battlecry discovers. Then [[Shamanic Tidecaller||133026]] converts all of it: under [[Balinda Stonehearth||130298]], cast everything into it - bloodgems, [[Oozeling Gladiator||103670]] spells. Grow premium hand Murlocs ([[Bile Spitter||122219]], [[Expert Aviator||126637]]) for summon value; [[Choral Mrrrglr||98948]] duplicates the hand's stats.

aberrations-deity-feed.name: Aberrations - Deity Feed
aberrations-deity-feed.enable_src: player-curated 2026-09-28 — the t3/t4 openers (Drifting Sacrifice, Mindbending Recruiter, Nightmare Corroder) that identify the direction before any t5 core lands; the comp meter's leaning lane reads these
aberrations-deity-feed.source: own replay corpus (comp_miner.py, 2026-09-23); core/helpers player-curated 2026-09-24; promoted to a first-class comp 2026-09-26 (player decision): the published aberrations-deathrattle-spells (S/Easy) shares Converter/Titus/Sapper/Corroder/Shadow of Doubt but this is the distinct deity-pool spell-scaling build the player actually plays — a comp_miner --promote re-run now REFUSES to touch a non-provisional row
aberrations-deity-feed.summary: Feed the Deity on two axes: deathrattle pay (Faceless Converter gives the Deity +1/+1 improved per tavern spell cast, N'raqi Sapper hands you Energizing Chambers, +7/+7 each, cast twice if discarded, Drifting Sacrifice is the t3 on-ramp) doubled by Titus Rivendare; and end-of-turn spell scaling (Felfire Conjurer and N'raqi Frostcaller make tavern spells give an extra +1/+1 this game, Mysterious K'Thir pays +8/+8 per discarded spell) doubled by Drakkari Enchanter. Helpers: Mindbending Recruiter (Activate: discard a card, get a random Aberration) with The Shadow of Doubt paying the Deity +3/+4 on every hand-add, and Nightmare Corroder banking Sludge Corrosions. Player-curated 2026-09-24 (core/helpers rewritten from the comp_miner 2-card provisional).
aberrations-deity-feed.when_to_commit: When the board is majority Aberration and two or more of the core cards are held or bought.

_enable_note: enable = pieces that OPEN the direction (lean); core = the commit point (Jeef, 'Direction' video: enablers are not commit points). Table verified against the card DB 2026-09-24. Resolved to ids: Brann Bronzebeard BG_LOE_077 (dragons, murlocs), Primalfin Lookout BGS_020 (murlocs), Titus Rivendare BG25_354 (pirates), Sly Raptor BG25_806 (Slamma beasts), Scrap Scraper BG26_148 (mechs), Wrath Weaver BGS_004 + Soul Rewinder BG26_174 (self-damage demons). The video's remaining names predate the current card set and have no id anywhere in minions.json: Smuggler (dragons), Genie/Wraith/Rock Rock (elementals), Boogie/Spearhide/Piper (quilboar), Orgozoa/Lord of Gains/A.F. Kay (nagas; Kay is a hero in heroes.json, so that clause is likely a transcript garble), Sore Loser/Champion of the Primus/Sister Death Speaker (undead). Those tribes get no enable row until their current-season openers are named. Pool membership is deliberately NOT claimed here: pool_roster is log-mined from 3 games (2026-09-22), too thin to prune by.

murlocs-keyword.name: Murlocs - Keyword
murlocs-keyword.summary: Add Keywords to Murlocs and buff them

aberrations-deathrattle-spells.name: Aberrations - Deathrattle/Spells
aberrations-deathrattle-spells.summary: Play spells and proc deathrattle to scale Deity
aberrations-deathrattle-spells.when_to_commit:
Faceless Converter + Titus Rivendare
Sky Admiral Rogers + Proud Privateer pivot highest cap

menagerie.name: Menagerie
menagerie.summary: Cast targetted spells to scale all tribes
menagerie.when_to_commit: Gatekeeper Amalgam + Balinda Stonehearth or spell power (Dark Puppeteer)
menagerie.how_to_play: Spell-target multiplier engine: cast friendly-targeted spells at Gatekeeper Amalgam (it casts Misplaced Tea Set back) with Balinda Stonehearth doubling every cast and Brann doubling battlecries. Blood Gems are its best food (Victorious Geomant/Hot-Air Surveyor keep the gems landing on it); keep Belinda - selling her is a pivot signal, and Faceless Converter re-summons double-dip since the Amalgam counts as an Aberration. Alternate minion and spell buys: the build eats spell casts as fuel.

mechs-apm-magnetic.name: Mechs - APM Magnetic
mechs-apm-magnetic.when_to_commit: Infinite gold (Sky Admiral Rogers + Proud Privateer) + Auto Reveille
mechs-apm-magnetic.how_to_play: APM chain engine: buy 3 cards to fire Auto Reveille, play mechs so Spark Snapper magnetizes and improves, let Polarizing Beatboxer mirror every attach, and time Drone Duplicator Activate before the biggest one. Rogers/Privateer print doubled Bounties off the same spending.

aberrations-apm-deity.name: Aberrations - APM Deity
aberrations-apm-deity.when_to_commit: Sky Admiral Rogers + Proud Privateer + The Shadow of Doubt
aberrations-apm-deity.common_enablers:
The Shadow of Doubt
Sky Admiral Rogers
aberrations-apm-deity.how_to_play: Spend-gold Deity engine: Sky Admiral Rogers mints Bounties every 9 gold spent, Proud Privateer casts them twice, every tavern spell gives Sha of Fear board+Deity pump, and every hand-add feeds The Shadow of Doubt. Gold in hand is wasted fuel - spend it.

elementals-living-azerite.name: Elementals - Living Azerite
elementals-living-azerite.when_to_commit: Brann Bronzebeard + Living Azerite + good economy
elementals-living-azerite.how_to_play: Shop-buff scaler: every tavern spell you cast gives elementals in the TAVERN +3/+2 permanently (Living Azerite), so buy the buffed bodies before rolling. Balinda doubles targeted spells; Leyline Surfacer generates Absorptions on both battlecry and deathrattle.

aberrations-sludge.name: Aberrations - Sludge
aberrations-sludge.when_to_commit: Spell generation (Nightmare Corroder, Sludge Portrait) + Spell Power (N'raqi Frostcaller)
aberrations-sludge.how_to_play: Spell-scaling aberrations: press Nraqi Frostcaller (free) every turn, feed KThir your left-most hand spells (+8/+8 each), bank permanent spell quality off Corroder and Dark Puppeteer deaths (Titus doubles), and remember discarded Sludge Corrosions cast twice.

quilboar-apm-shop-buff.name: Quilboar - APM Shop Buff
quilboar-apm-shop-buff.summary: Cast spells to consume buffed shop.
quilboar-apm-shop-buff.how_to_play: APM shop-buff engine: Rogers mints a Bounty every 9 gold and Privateer casts Bounties twice, while Balinda doubles friendly-targeted spells. Stream spells into Devilish Distractor to pump the tavern +2/+2 per cast, then Felboar consumes the buffed shop every 3 spells. Blood Gems (Surveyor/Geomant) are cheap fuel; keep the carry left-most for Geomant overflow.

demons-deathrattle-shop-buff.name: Demons - Deathrattle/Shop Buff
demons-deathrattle-shop-buff.summary: Scale and eat the shop with deathrattles.
demons-deathrattle-shop-buff.how_to_play: Deathrattle shop-buff: press Sacrificial Wrathguard's Activate (1) every turn - its deathrattle gives minions in the Tavern +2/+2 for the rest of the game - and let Titus Rivendare trigger it twice. Imp-lusionist deaths feed you Methodical Madness (choose a Demon; it consumes 2 random Tavern minions to gain their stats and bonus keywords), which is how the buffed Tavern becomes board stats, and Balinda Stonehearth casts each one twice. Soulkeeping Jailer's Activate (2) is the bulk eater: every Demon consumes a random Tavern minion. Twisted Wrathguard refills the shop with Fodder after each sell, so keep buying and selling to keep the conversion running.

quilboar-gems-from-hand.name: Quilboar - Gems from Hand
quilboar-gems-from-hand.when_to_commit: Gem scaling (Sanguine Refiner) + Hot Air Surveyor
quilboar-gems-from-hand.how_to_play: Blood Gems played from HAND: Hot-Air Surveyor makes every gem you play from hand cast an extra time, so the payoff is a hand full of gems rather than one gem a turn. Victorious Geomant's Activate (2) hands you 6 at once and casts the overflow onto your left-most minion - keep the carry there - and Mangled Bandit trades a discard for 3 more. Scale the gems themselves with Sanguine Refiner's Rally and Sanguine Champion's battlecry and deathrattle; both boosts are permanent. Balinda Stonehearth doubles each gem you cast, and Geomagus Roogug chains a second gem off itself whenever one lands on it.

murlocs-magicfin.name: Murlocs - Magicfin
murlocs-magicfin.summary: Teach Murlocs spells and proc them
murlocs-magicfin.when_to_commit: Brann Bronzebeard + Magicfin Mycologist + Young Murk-eye
murlocs-magicfin.how_to_play: Taught-spell Murlocs: buy a Tavern spell every turn so Magicfin Mycologist hands you a 1/1 Murloc carrying that spell, then re-cast it - Brann Bronzebeard doubles the carry minion's battlecry, and Young Murk-Eye triggers an adjacent battlecry again at end of turn (Drakkari Enchanter makes that twice). Felfire Conjurer and Red Chromadrake are the scaling half: each permanently improves what your Tavern spells give, so the spells you teach get better all game. Draconic Warden's battlecry and deathrattle keep the Chromadrakes coming. Easiest line in the family to pilot - park the token next to Murk-Eye and buy spells.

dragons-copebringer.name: Dragons - Copebringer
dragons-copebringer.how_to_play: Divine-shield engine: Hopebringer gives your board +3/+3 at the start of combat and improves permanently every time a friendly minion loses Divine Shield, so the whole plan is to pop shields. Heroic Broodmother gains one on each Rally and attacks immediately at the start of combat; Nadina the Red re-shields 3 Dragons when she dies; Bronze Warden's divine shield plus reborn is two losses in one body. Park the Dragons you care about beside Persistent Poet - it keeps their combat stats and bonus keywords for good. Crimson Hand Centurion is a cheap extra shield that also grows off Verdant Spheres.
